entities.summary: Ngawang Jigme Drakpa was the last ruling prince of Tsang of the Rinpungpa Dynasty, who ruled from 1565 until his death in 1597. He was a renowned author and a key figure in the politics of the region. His reign was marked by increasing chaos and power struggles within the dynasty. The Rinpungpa Dynasty was eventually deprived of its main possessions by the Tsangpa dynasty in 1565. Ngawang Jigme Drakpa's legacy is that of a ruler who struggled to maintain control in the face of internal strife and external pressures. He died in 1597, and his death marked the end of the Rinpungpa Dynasty's rule over Tsang. Ngawang Jigme Drakpa's writings have survived to the present day and offer valuable insights into the politics and culture of the region during his time. His works include 'The History of the Rinpungpa Dynasty' and 'The Chronicles of Tsang'. Ngawang Jigme Drakpa's story is one of a ruler who fought to maintain his power and legacy in the face of overwhelming odds. He was a symbol of the struggle for control in the region and his legacy continues to be felt today.
